title: SWF publish: StartSound envelope/in-point/out-point silently dropped
description:
encodeStartSound in packages/swf/src/audio.ts (line 237-242) hardcodes HasEnvelope=0, HasInPoint=0, HasOutPoint=0 as MVP stubs. The model fully supports SoundLinkage.inPoint, outPoint, effect (preset fades/pans), and customEnvelope (SoundEnvelopePoint[]). compile.ts (lines 1990-1993) passes these fields to encodeStartSound but they are silently discarded.

Any FLA with sound in/out points, fade effects, or custom envelopes will play incorrectly (full sound, no fading, no panning, no trim).

Fix: implement the HasInPoint, HasOutPoint, and HasEnvelope fields in encodeStartSound per SWF spec §7.5.2.
